scripts.build: npx cap sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:unix: npx cap sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build-release: npx cap sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.build-release:unix: npx cap sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease

scripts.licenses:check:unix: npm run licenses:npm && npm run licenses:android:unix
